phase: Phase 7 — Fast Scene-Fit Benchmark for Frozen MMR-1
purpose: Measure the smallest deterministic same-shot representative-frame and pixel budget that estimates the frozen Matrix 08 Phase-6 MMR-1 transform with practically no output-quality loss. This is not model development and does not authorize production integration or full-film processing.

frozen_mmr1_contract.final_luminance_rule: reimpose each frame's Model-E Y_target after ICtCp inverse

source_paths.open_matte: G:\Filmy\IMAX format (open matte)\The Matrix (1999) [OPEN MATTE] [WEB-DL 1080p 10bit DD5.1 x265].mkv

reproducibility_control.definition: Re-decode all five fixed Matrix 08 pairs and recompute the Phase-6 B4 (10/25/50/75%) pooled transform using the original 4096 training and 2048 heldout rows per training frame before testing any reduced budget.
reproducibility_control.failure_action: Stop as REPRODUCIBILITY_FAILURE. Do not interpret or recommend a reduced budget.

benchmark_frame_budgets.temporal_holdout: 90% remains excluded from every production-eligible H0 and MMR fit and is applied/evaluated only after fitting.

five_frame_diagnostic.label: NO_TEMPORAL_HOLDOUT_REFERENCE_COMPARISON_ONLY
five_frame_diagnostic.reason: It consumes the predeclared 90% temporal holdout and therefore cannot support a temporal-generalization or production-budget claim.

benchmark_pixel_budgets.candidate_row_definition: Each number is the exact number of deterministic spatial training rows supplied by one representative frame to H0 and MMR fitting. Full-frame application and full-overlap reference-output comparison are permitted only after fitting and are not candidate fit rows.
benchmark_pixel_budgets.selection_rule: For each frame, preserve the frozen spatial train mask ((y//80+x//120)%5)!=0 and select an evenly spaced deterministic prefix-independent subset of the mask using integer linspace positions. The first n rows are not used. No random, content-adaptive, saliency, or learned sampling is permitted.
benchmark_pixel_budgets.lambda_holdout_rows_per_frame: Use an equally deterministic subset of the frozen heldout mask with min(2048, max(250, round(fit_rows_per_frame/2))) rows per training frame only to preserve frozen lambda selection. These rows are not included in the declared fit-row budget.
benchmark_pixel_budgets.eligible_pixel_count_rule: A requested candidate is invalid if either frozen mask has fewer required rows; no substitution or duplicated row is permitted.

fit_apply_separation.H0_and_MMR_fit_frames: Only the labels in the candidate frame budget.

equivalence_and_validity.comparison: Candidate output minus Phase-6-reference-transform output, over the fixed 1,536,000-pixel overlap for each of all five applied frames.
equivalence_and_validity.quality_summary: Report median and worst frame of per-frame mean/P95 differences, together with direct HDR-reference metrics; equivalence selection uses the reference-output differences.
required_validity: Y_target reimposition maximum absolute error <= 1e-05 nits
all output applications use exactly the one candidate coefficient matrix
equivalence_and_validity.recommended_candidate_selection: Choose the production-eligible candidate with the fewest total fit rows (frame_count × fit_rows_per_frame) that passes every per-frame equivalence and validity requirement. Break a tie by fewer frames, then fewer rows per frame.

measurement.timing_scope: Warm-cache fit-only H0 plus pooled MMR lambda sweep; separately record source extraction/decode, full-frame application, evaluation, and artifact writing. Do not label combined timing as fit time.
measurement.memory: Record process peak RSS for every candidate repetition. GPU memory is not inferred or claimed unless measured by an available local GPU telemetry tool.
measurement.throughput_projection: Use the selected configuration median and worst fit time, multiplied by 100, 500, and 1000 shots; report fit-only separately from decode and apply timings.

visual_artifacts.generate_for: Only the selected production-eligible candidate and the Phase-6 reference, for the five fixed frames.
visual_artifacts.prohibited: No visual panels for every sweep point and no full-shot/full-film render.

cross_scene_sanity.policy: EXCLUDED_BY_PHASE6_STATUS unless an existing Phase-6 case is both SCORABLE and permitted by the fixed Phase-6 status. Do not discover a new anchor, expand a window, change geometry, or refit sync.

required_final_answers: A. recommended representative frames per shot
B. recommended fit rows per representative frame
C. recommended total fit rows per shot
D. median and worst-case fitting time
E. expected analysis time per 100/500/1000 shots
G. expected quality difference versus the Phase-6 reference transform
H. practicality for a local RTX 3080 / CPU workflow
stop_rule: Stop after the benchmark report. Do not change MMR-1, create a new model, integrate production, process the full film, or render a full shot.
